\begin{document}
For a single level coupled to wide-band leads with $\Gamma>0$, the retarded Green's function is
\begin{equation}
G^R(\omega) = \frac{1}{\omega - \varepsilon_d + i\Gamma/2} .
\label{eq:gr}
\end{equation}
Separating real and imaginary parts,
\begin{equation}
G^R(\omega) = \frac{\omega - \varepsilon_d - i\Gamma/2}{(\omega-\varepsilon_d)^2 + \Gamma^2/4} .
\label{eq:gr2}
\end{equation}
\end{document}
